name: Agentic
title: agentic.so
payoff: The App Store for LLM Tools
shortDescription: Agentic provides a suite of tools optimized for large language models (LLMs), offering seamless integration via MCP servers and HTTP APIs. Designed specifically for LLM applications, Agentic enhances user experience with easy-to-debug tools and production-ready reliability. Example use case: using @agentic/search to enable LLMs to access web content efficiently.
pros: Supports both MCP and HTTP API integrations
cons: May be overly specialized for non-LLM use cases
Dependent on external services like Cloudflare and Stripe
Limited information on scalability and handling high loads
